title: Healthy Eating Habits — HS Defensive Lineman
summary: Build functional trench mass, recover faster between lifts and practice, and avoid sluggish weight from empty calories.

portionRule.examples: Chicken breast, lean ground beef (90/10+), eggs, Greek yogurt, turkey, salmon, tuna
Oats, brown/white rice, whole-grain pasta, potatoes, sweet potatoes, fruit, whole-wheat wraps
Spinach, broccoli, bell peppers, berries, bananas, oranges — fights inflammation & soreness
Avocado, olive oil, peanut/almond butter, mixed nuts, chia seeds

habits.title: Hit 80-100 oz of water + electrolytes
habits.detail: Carry a 32 oz bottle at school and refill 3x. Add a pinch of salt or low-sugar electrolyte packet before practice.
habits.whyItMatters: Even 2% dehydration drops sprint speed, grip strength, and mental snap reaction.

habits.title: Never skip breakfast before school
habits.detail: Eat 30g+ protein + complex carbs within 60 min of waking (e.g., 3-4 eggs + oatmeal + banana).
habits.whyItMatters: Skipping breakfast forces your body to break down muscle tissue during morning classes and afternoon lifts.

habits.title: Anchor every meal with 30-40g lean protein
habits.detail: Spread protein across 4 meals/snacks instead of trying to cram it all at dinner.
habits.whyItMatters: Steady amino acids rebuild muscle fibers damaged in heavy lower/upper body sessions.

habits.title: Pre-training carb + light protein fuel
habits.detail: Banana with peanut butter, bagel with turkey, or Greek yogurt + berries before hitting the weight room or turf.
habits.whyItMatters: Tops off muscle glycogen so your 4th set and last 10-yard sprint stay explosive.

habits.title: Post-workout recovery within 45 minutes
habits.detail: Low-fat chocolate milk, whey/protein shake + fruit, or chicken & rice soon after training.
habits.whyItMatters: Jump-starts muscle repair and replenishes energy for the next school day.

habits.title: 2+ servings of fruit or vegetables daily
habits.detail: Include greens or bright produce on your lunch tray and dinner plate.
habits.whyItMatters: Micronutrients, potassium, and antioxidants protect joints and reduce cramping.

habits.title: Skip soda, energy drinks & fried fast food
habits.detail: Swap sugary energy drinks and deep-fried sides for water, milk, grilled proteins, and baked potatoes.
habits.whyItMatters: Empty sugar and fried fats add slow body fat without adding force to your punch or get-off.

habits.title: Lock in 8.5-9.5 hours of sleep
habits.detail: Screens off 30 min before bed; optionally have Greek yogurt or milk if hungry late.
habits.whyItMatters: Growth hormone release and nervous-system recovery for explosive days happen during deep sleep.

sampleMealPlan.meal: 3-4 scrambled eggs, 2 slices whole-grain toast, 1 cup oatmeal with berries, 16 oz water
Double chicken/turkey sandwich or grilled chicken bowl with rice, black beans, and steamed veggies + apple
1 banana + 2 tbsp peanut butter or trail mix + 16-20 oz water with electrolytes
6-8 oz lean beef/chicken/salmon, large baked potato or rice, broccoli/salad with olive oil, 12 oz milk
1 cup Greek yogurt or cottage cheese with pineapple or honey
